description:
## Why

Per PKIX-amgn.8 decisions (2026-05-11), the refresh tool body. Transforms 'zlint -listLintsJSON' output into per-profile-family OSCAL Catalog JSON documents.

## What

In pkix-lint-cabf-refresh/src/main.rs (or split into modules):

### Input

`zlint -listLintsJSON` produces a JSON array. Each element has shape (approximate, confirm against zlint source):
```
{
  "name": "e_basic_constraints_not_critical",
  "description": "basicConstraints MUST appear as a critical extension in CA certs",
  "citation": "RFC 5280: 4.2.1.9",
  "source": "RFCBaselineRequirements",
  "effectiveDate": "2008-05-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```

### Source-filtering (output one catalog per profile family)

- Source == 'CABFBaselineRequirements' -> cabf-br-tls catalog
- Source == 'CABFSMIMEBaselineRequirements' -> cabf-br-smime catalog
- Source == 'CABFEVGuidelines' -> cabf-br-tls-ev catalog (or fold into cabf-br-tls; TBD by impl)
- Source == 'CABFCSBaselineRequirements' -> cabf-br-cs catalog
- Other sources (RFC*, Apple*, Mozilla*, etc.) -> not emitted by this tool (out of scope for amgn.8; rfc lints stay in pkix-lint catalog authored separately)

### Field mapping (zlint -> OSCAL Control)

- `Name` -> `control.id` (e.g. 'e_basic_constraints_not_critical')
- `Description` -> `control.parts[name=statement].prose`
- `Citation` -> `control.links[rel=cites]` (preserve original string) + `control.props[name=br-section]` (parsed section, e.g. '7.1.4.2.2')
- `Source` -> `control.props[name=source-classification]`
- `EffectiveDate` -> `control.props[name=effective-date]` (RFC 3339)

### Catalog metadata (per output catalog)

- `metadata.title`: e.g. 'CA/B Forum TLS Baseline Requirements (zlint-derived)'
- `metadata.last-modified`: current UTC time at tool run
- `metadata.oscal-version`: '1.2.2' (pinned per PKIX-9vnx.1)
- `metadata.parties`:
  - reference-source role: zlint upstream project (name 'zlint', URL 'https://github.com/zmap/zlint', license Apache-2.0)
  - One party with role='reference-source' for zlint
- `metadata.remarks`: 'Derived from zlint <SHA> via pkix-lint-cabf-refresh. Reference / not authoritative. Licensed upstream under Apache-2.0; see NOTICE in pkix-lint-cabf crate root.'

### Output

- File path: `pkix-lint-cabf/catalogs/<family>-derived-from-zlint-<sha7>.oscal.json`
- Schema validation: validate emitted JSON against NIST OSCAL Catalog v1.2.2 schema. Either via:
  - oscal-cli (if installed) — invoke as subprocess after write
  - schemars-based validation against vendored schema (heavier; defer)
  - First pass: skip schema validation, document the gap, file follow-up bd
- CLI flags:
  - `--zlint-output <path>` (input JSON file; default: read stdin)
  - `--output-dir <path>` (default: ./pkix-lint-cabf/catalogs)
  - `--zlint-sha <sha>` (required; embedded in filename + metadata.remarks)

## Acceptance

- [ ] Tool runs end-to-end: `zlint -listLintsJSON | cargo run -p pkix-lint-cabf-refresh -- --zlint-sha $(git -C ~/GIT/zlint rev-parse --short HEAD) --output-dir /tmp/cabf-catalogs`
- [ ] At least the cabf-br-tls catalog is emitted with the correct filename pattern.
- [ ] Emitted JSON parses cleanly with serde_json::from_str (no malformed output).
- [ ] Each Control has all five required fields (id, statement prose, citation link, source-classification prop, effective-date prop).
- [ ] Metadata.parties contains the zlint reference-source entry with license=Apache-2.0.
- [ ] Smoke check: schema validation either passes against NIST OSCAL Catalog v1.2.2 schema OR follow-up bd filed for schema-validation gap.

## Out of scope

- Vendoring the actual output catalog (PKIX-amgn.8.4).
- The runtime parser in pkix-lint-cabf (PKIX-amgn.8.5).
- Generating catalogs for non-CABF sources (RFC lints, Mozilla policy lints, etc.).

## Depends on

PKIX-amgn.8.2 (sub-crate skeleton).

## Filed by

Decomposed from PKIX-amgn.8 per Mark's 2026-05-11 decisions.
notes:
Escalating to human (2026-05-11): bead's input/output spec has six material discrepancies against zlint v3.7.0 + pkix-lint::oscal. Several lock the downstream parser (PKIX-amgn.8.5) into the choice.

1. Source name strings (bead vs reality):
   - Bead: 'CABFBaselineRequirements' / 'CABFSMIMEBaselineRequirements' / 'CABFEVGuidelines' / 'CABFCSBaselineRequirements'
   - Actual: 'CABF_BR' / 'CABF_SMIME_BR' / 'CABF_EV' / 'CABF_CS_BR'
   - Mechanical fix; no decision needed (use the actual strings).

2. Effective date field is NOT in zlint -list-lints-json output.
   - Bead requires `effectiveDate` as a Control prop mapping.
   - zlint v3.7.0 lint/base.go:88: `EffectiveDate time.Time \`json:"-"\`` — deliberately omitted from serialized output.
   - Bead's acceptance criterion 'Each Control has all five required fields (..., effective-date prop)' is unsatisfiable.
   - Decision: (a) drop effective-date from spec, (b) parse zlint Go source to extract EffectiveDate constants (heavy + brittle), (c) accept gap and emit Controls with effective-date absent.
   - Recommendation: (a). zlint treats EffectiveDate as runtime-only metadata.

3. OSCAL version:
   - Bead: '1.2.2'.
   - pkix-lint constant: '1.1.2' (pkix-lint/src/oscal/catalog.rs:81, emit.rs:80).
   - Decision: align bead to 1.1.2, or bump pkix-lint workspace-wide first.
   - Recommendation: 1.1.2 for this round; workspace OSCAL bump deserves its own bead.

4. Prop namespace for zlint-derived Controls:
   - pkix-lint emits props as `pkix-lint.citation`, `pkix-lint.severity`, `pkix-lint.scope`, `pkix-lint.applies-to`, `pkix-lint.section-id`, `pkix-lint.lint-id`.
   - zlint NDJSON has only name/description/citation/source. No severity / scope / applies-to.
   - Decision: (a) reuse `pkix-lint.*` prop names with missing fields absent, (b) use `zlint.*` namespace.
   - Recommendation: (b). Vendoring is 'we vendor zlint metadata'; the prefix makes provenance line-of-sight obvious. PKIX-amgn.8.5 handles both anyway because pkix-lint's RFC-conformance catalog uses pkix-lint.*.

5. Severity prefix decoding:
   - zlint encodes severity in name prefix: e_* (353) = error, w_* (55) = warning, n_* (11) = notice. Not exposed as a separate JSON field.
   - Decision: (a) decode prefix into a `zlint.severity` prop, (b) leave implicit in id.
   - Recommendation: (a). Structured access is the point of vendoring as OSCAL.

6. EV catalog: bead says 'cabf-br-tls-ev catalog (or fold into cabf-br-tls; TBD by impl)'.
   - Recommendation: separate catalog. CA/B Forum EV Guidelines is a distinct document with its own ballot lifecycle; zlint keeps them separate sources.

Empirical counts from zlint -list-lints-json on v3.7.0 HEAD 77ce217f: CABF_BR=170, CABF_SMIME_BR=36, CABF_EV=14, CABF_CS_BR=11. With separate-EV the tool emits 4 OSCAL Catalog JSON files.

Releasing the claim. Next ready beads exist; loop continues.
Frozen 2026-05-12 (PKIX-ncab.2 cascade): parent PKIX-amgn.8 re-scoped because OSCAL is no longer prescribed as the catalog format. This issue is a snapshot of the OSCAL-target version of the work; it will be reworked, closed, or replaced when the replacement policy/config format is decided. Until then, do not claim autonomously.
title: Implement zlint JSON -> OSCAL Catalog transform in pkix-lint-cabf-refresh
